{
  "summary": "The function fn_18 appears to be a parser that checks if the input string is a valid C-style string literal. It returns the length of the input if it is a valid string literal, otherwise, it returns an error code.",
  "proposed_name": "fn_18",
  "algorithm": "unknown",
  "self_confidence": 0.9,
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "1",

      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 0.9
    },
    {
      "id": "2",
      "type": "IO",
      "text": "Returns the length of the input if it is a valid string literal.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 0.9
    },
    {
      "id": "3",
      "type": "IO",
      "text": "Returns VERA_ERR when the input is not a valid string literal.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 0.9
    },
    {
      "id": "4",
      "type": "SIDE",
      "text": "Does not modify the input or output.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 0.9
    },
    {
      "id": "5",
      "type": "CF",
      "text": "Uses a loop to iterate through the input string.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 0.9
    }
  ],
  "recovered_c": "uint64_t fn_18(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, uint64_t arg, uint8_t *out, size_t out_cap) {\n  if (out_cap < len) {\n    return VERA_ERR;\n  }\n  for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n    if (in[i] == '\\\"') {\n      if (i == 0 || in[i - 1] != '\\\\') {\n        return VERA_ERR;\n      }\n    } else if (in[i] == '\\\\') {\n      if (i == 0) {\n        return VERA_ERR;\n      }\n    } else if (in[i] == '(' || in[i] == '[' || in[i] == '{') {\n      if (i == 0) {\n        return VERA_ERR;\n      }\n    } else if (in[i] == ')' || in[i] == ']' || in[i] == '}') {\n      if (i == 0) {\n        return VERA_ERR;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  return len;\n}"
}
